query:
UPDATE relay_invocations
           SET trust_snapshot = COALESCE(trust_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)
               || jsonb_build_object(
                    'system_one',
                    COALESCE(trust_snapshot->'system_one', '{}'::jsonb)
                        || jsonb_build_object('reply_safety', $2::jsonb))
         WHERE id = $1
